title: Circular directing TSPs to deny new SIMs beyond nine connections per subscriber
what_happened: Reported circular directs telcos to block new mobile connections for subscribers already holding nine SIMs, effective 24-08-2026, with Digital Intelligence Platform verification of the existing base by 30-11-2026. Circular text not on any official venue as of 24-08-2026.

title: Reference letter to TRAI seeking review of the 2017 net neutrality framework
what_happened: DoT letter dated 08-07-2026 asks TRAI for recommendations on reviewing net neutrality norms to accommodate 5G network slicing and differentiated services. Reference letters are not published; expect a TRAI consultation paper as the next public artefact.

title: Central Delhi mobile internet shutdown with no published suspension order
what_happened: No issuing authority named; MHA, GNCTD and DoT all unconfirmed. Mobile internet suspended in parts of Central Delhi on 20-07-2026 during the 'Chalo Sansad' march; no suspension order under the Temporary Suspension of Services Rules, 2024 was made public.
